description: This file defines a SwiftUI view, ChatMarkdownRenderer, that renders markdown with specific styles and images, tailored for chat interfaces. It also includes supporting styles and image list views, and makes use of custom preprocessors and external image factories.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownRenderer
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that renders markdown text with styling and images based on context and variant.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Renders the processed markdown and images in a vertical stack with specific styles.
